title: SMB signups in Q1 2025
prompt: How many accounts in the smb segment signed up during Q1 2025 (Jan–Mar)?
population: Accounts with segment = smb and signed_up_at in Q1 2025.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FROM accounts WHERE segment = 'smb' AND signed_up_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND signed_up_at < DATE '2025-04-01'
